title: Pharmacokinetic profiling of rituximab in glomerular diseases: key determinants and implications for personalized therapy.
caption: Factors influencing the blood concentration of RTX.
context: Factors influencing the blood concentration of RTX. RTX is governed not by an isolated determinant, but by an interconnected pharmacokinetic network involving disease-specific immunological activity (which modulates target antigen burden and the risk of ADA development), direct renal sequelae (notably proteinuria), and patient-specific factors (including polymorphisms in the FcRn) ( Figure 1 ).
